sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The advice for this is the service of "remembering" Havayah, which is a level above limitation, drawing the revelation of the encompassing light.

translations.translation: And the advice for this is "Remember Havayah,"
that the service should be in a manner of remembrance,
above limitation
(each day they should be in your eyes as new),
through which the revelation of Havayah shines,
the encompassing light that is also above enclothing.
And one can connect this with the Baal Shem Tov's interpretation of the verse,
"What was for us" is the revelation of the Mah of the soul,
for the Mah of the soul is the essence of the soul, above enclothing,
which is connected to Havayah that is above enclothing in the world,
and through this one comes to the service of "Remember,"
a service above limitation.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This explains "Zion shall be redeemed through justice and her captives through charity" as two levels of the soul: Zion is the soul above enclothing, and her captives are the soul within enclothing, redeemed through Torah and mitzvos respectively.

translations.translation: And this is "Zion shall be redeemed through justice and her captives through charity,"
which are two levels in the soul.
Zion is the level of the soul that is above enclothing in the body
(the Mah of the soul),
this level cannot be captive in the animal soul,
that its bitterness and joy be from worldly matters,
rather it is only in exile,
that it does not shine in revelation
(in the soul within the body).
And "her captives" is the level of the soul that is in enclothing,
this level can be captive in the animal soul,
that its bitterness and joy are from worldly matters.
And it can be said,
that it is in the manner explained
in the interpretation of the verse
"And Zion said, 'Havayah has forsaken me, and my Lord has forgotten me,'"
that forgetfulness is that there is something that causes forgetfulness, not merely the absence of memory.
And this is "Havayah has forsaken me, and my Lord has forgotten me,"
regarding Havayah, which is the encompassing light above enclothing in the worlds, forgetfulness does not apply, G-d forbid, only the matter of forsaking,
and it is that in exile, the Holy One, blessed be He, ascends above and does not shine in revelation below
(like the exile of the level of Zion,
which does not shine in the soul within the body),
and "my Lord"
(Malchus)
which generally is the filling light,
the matter of forgetfulness can apply to it,
the descent of Malchus to vitalize the husks
(like the captivity of the level of the soul in the aspect of enclothing,
whose bitterness and joy can be from worldly matters).
And this is
"Zion shall be redeemed through justice and her captives through charity,"
that the redemption of the level of Zion from the things that cover it and prevent its revelation in the soul within the body,
is through Torah
[justice is the laws of Torah,
as the Targum renders
"according to the first judgment" as "according to the first law"],
for Torah is light
(Torah is light)
and therefore through it the revelation of the level of Zion is brought about.
And the redemption of the level of the soul that is in enclothing, which is captive in the animal soul
(and her captives)
is through charity,
that is, all the mitzvos which are called charity,
and particularly through literal charity,
for regarding charity it is written
"Your commandment is exceedingly broad,"
that through the mitzvah of charity the revelation of the light of the boundless is drawn,
and the revelation is also in the soul enclothed in the body,
[and likewise above – in the Sefirah of Malchus, which is called the Shechinah, on account of
that it enclothes itself in the lower beings to vitalize them],
and in a manner of enclothing.
And through this is also drawn the revelation of the very essence of the soul,
which is above even the level of the soul that is above enclothing,
and in the manner explained above
(section 3)
that the unification of the encompassing and the filling is through the revelation of the power of the Essence.
And since "He has also placed the world in their hearts,"
behold, through this it is also drawn into the world,
that the revelation of that which is above nature
(drawn from the encompassing)
will be revealed also within nature
(drawn from the filling),
and through this there will also be the revelation of the Essence
(which connects both of them),
through which the intention of a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms will be completed,
for Him, for His Essence.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: May the promise of "Zion shall be redeemed through justice and her captives through charity" be fulfilled soon through the King Moshiach, bringing redemption and perfection to the world.

translations.translation: And may it be His will,
that very soon the promise and assurance "Zion shall be redeemed through justice and her captives through charity" be fulfilled,
that there will arise
a king from the house of Dovid, engrossed in Torah
(justice)
and occupied with mitzvos
(charity),
and he will wage the wars of Havayah and prevail
[for it can be said that this waging of the wars of Havayah is through the service
in the level of the soul enclothed in the body,
that the service in this level
is in a manner of war with the animal soul],
and he will build the Sanctuary in its place
[so that through this there will be revelation also in the entire world,
for the windows of the Holy Temple were narrow within and wide without,
from which light emanates to the entire world]
and he will gather the dispersed of Israel and perfect the world
entirely to serve Havayah,
and all this – very soon and in our time.
